<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/farming-bot">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmPreferences</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Bot" name="Bot creation started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set urgency of resources">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Deps_Check" name="Prerequisites missing?" default="Flow_Deps_Complete">

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmPreferences" name="Confirm all preferences">

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSub_UpdateList" name="Update materials list" triggeredByEvent="true">

        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterials" name="Update list of materials to farm">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose friends and sharing options">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Sharing options" default="Flow_Share_None">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Share_None</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">

    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send_Done</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join" name="Sharing completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Send_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Share_None</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Done" name="Bot sharing completed">

    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Bot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_ApplyDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ApplyDependencies" targetRef="Gateway_Deps_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deps_Missing" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Deps_Check" targetRef="Task_AddPrerequisites">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${prerequisitesMissing}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddPrereq_Loop" sourceRef="Task_AddPrerequisites" targetRef="Task_ApplyDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deps_Complete" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Deps_Check" targetRef="Task_ConfirmPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmPreferences" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag" name="Brag selected" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${bragRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${sendMaterialsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share_None" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Done" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Done" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="End_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Done" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Done" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="End_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_UpdateMaterials" name="Materials list update requested"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_Milestone" name="Milestone reached"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Bot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUrgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseSharing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Share_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Share_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BotAutomation" name="Bot automation">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ToolCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildTool</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ToolMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Farming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Bot" name="Player wants to create a farming bot"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set urgency of resources"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ToolCheck" name="Tool required for gathering?" default="Flow_ToolNotNeeded"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildTool" name="Build required tool"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ToolMerge" name="Ready to gather"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Farming" name="Farming started"/>

      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GatherResources" name="Gather resources"/>

      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FarmingFinished" name="Farming finished"/>

      <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Gather">
        <bpmn:text>Up to 10 resources are collected in parallel.</bpmn:text>
      </bpmn:textAnnotation>

      <bpmn:association id="Assoc_Gather" sourceRef="Task_GatherResources" targetRef="Annotation_Gather"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSub_Disaster" name="Natural disaster setback" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_Disaster"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_RecoverBot" name="Recover bot from setback"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Disaster" name="Bot recovered"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dis_1" sourceRef="Start_Disaster" targetRef="Task_RecoverBot"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dis_2" sourceRef="Task_RecoverBot" targetRef="End_Disaster"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSub_Milestone" name="Milestone notification" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_Milestone"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Milestone" name="Player notified"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Mil_1" sourceRef="Start_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Mil_2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="End_Milestone"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSub_UpdateList" name="Update materials list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_UpdateList" name="Materials list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_UpdateList" messageRef="Message_UpdateMaterials"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterials" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateList" name="Materials list updated"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Upd_1" sourceRef="Start_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterials"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Upd_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="End_UpdateList"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_1" sourceRef="Start_Farming" targetRef="Task_GatherResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherResources" targetRef="End_FarmingFinished"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose friends and sharing options"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Sharing options" default="Flow_Share_None"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join" name="Sharing completed"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Done" name="Bot sharing completed"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Urgency">
      <bpmn:text>Some resources are more urgently needed than others.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_Urgency" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Annotation_Urgency"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Bot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Gateway_ToolCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolCheck" targetRef="Task_BuildTool">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${toolBuildRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolNotNeeded" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ToolMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildDone" sourceRef="Task_BuildTool" targetRef="Gateway_ToolMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ToolMerge" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag" name="Brag selected" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bragRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendMaterialsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share_None" name="No sharing" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Done" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Done" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="End_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_UpdateMaterials" name="Materials list update requested"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_Milestone" name="Milestone reached"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Bot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FindResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUrgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_UpdateMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseSharing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Share_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Share_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Tool_Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateTool</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Tool_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecoverBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_UpdateRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Bot" name="Bot creation started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FindResources" name="Find out which resources you want">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Tool_Check" name="Tool needed?" default="Flow_ToolNotNeeded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToolNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToolNotNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreateTool" name="Create required tool">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToolNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Tool_Created</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Tool_Merge" name="Tool ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToolNotNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Tool_Created</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GatherResources" name="Gather resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Recover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_GatherResources" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_Disaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecoverBot" name="Recover bot from setback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Recover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_GatherResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_Milestone"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Milestone" name="Player notified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_UpdateRequest" name="Materials list update requested" attachedToRef="Task_GatherResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateReq</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_UpdateList" messageRef="Message_UpdateMaterials"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterials" name="Update list of materials to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateReq</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateMaterials" name="Materials list updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateDone</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose friends and sharing options">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Sharing requested" default="Flow_NoShare">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoShare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_Done</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Send_Done</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join" name="Sharing completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Send_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoShare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Done" name="Bot sharing completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Parallel">
      <bpmn:text>Up to 10 resources are collected in parallel</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Urgency">
      <bpmn:text>Some resources are more urgently needed than others</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Tools">
      <bpmn:text>Resources required to create tools needed to gather other resources (custom dependency logic)</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>

    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_Parallel" sourceRef="Annotation_Parallel" targetRef="Task_GatherResources"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_Urgency" sourceRef="Annotation_Urgency" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_Tools" sourceRef="Annotation_Tools" targetRef="Gateway_Tool_Check"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Bot" targetRef="Task_FindResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_FindResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Gateway_Tool_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolNeeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Tool_Check" targetRef="Task_CreateTool">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${toolRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolNotNeeded" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Tool_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Tool_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tool_Created" sourceRef="Task_CreateTool" targetRef="Gateway_Tool_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Tool_Merge" targetRef="Task_GatherResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_GatherResources" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_RecoverBot"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Recover" sourceRef="Task_RecoverBot" targetRef="Task_GatherResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="End_Milestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateReq" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_UpdateRequest" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDone" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="End_UpdateMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag" name="Brag selected" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bragRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendMaterialsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoShare" name="No sharing" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Done" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Done" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="End_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
